title: Carthage Amphitheatre
geometryBasis: Named Carthage archaeological site way, surviving wall centerline, two native ruin polygons and northeast approach. National Heritage Institute dimensions constrain the visible arena at 64.7 m by 36.7 m.
sectionBasis: The 2017 Qualla original controls the low retaining walls, tunnel opening, paired central arches, excavated passage, railing and commemorative cross. The published ancient upper tiers are absent from the represented state.

groundCutout.basis: Narrow openings inside mapped ruins way 153679399, interpreted against the 2017 photograph of the excavated passages.

limitations: The model represents the surviving excavated amphitheatre and modern site fittings seen in April 2017. The vanished Roman upper tiers are outside this dated scope.

The named archaeological outline, retaining wall and mapped ruins constrain the surviving structures. The heritage institute gives the arena dimensions. Wall breaks and original masonry courses are simplified.
The original Terrarium grid remains intact. A narrow modeled opening exposes the photographed passages in the viewer. The excavated floor depth and paving datum are estimates.
